about: The StemgenRT files the music separation module is built from (tools/build-stem-module.ps1). Pinned to one commit and checked by SHA-256; CI caches them by that commit (build.yml, job stem-module). The model is in Git LFS, so it comes from media.githubusercontent.com.
name: StemgenRT

vocals.about: The vocal branch that tools/extract-vocal-model.py cuts out of the model, weights unchanged; the worker checks this hash too.
